headline: Steady quarter · improved cost guidance · record TTM EBITDA
summary_short: Hudbay reported Q2 2026 revenue of $631.3M and net earnings of $137.4M (EPS $0.34), driven by steady copper and gold production. Trailing-twelve-month adjusted EBITDA hit a record $1.27B. Full-year cash-cost guidance was improved to $(0.45)-$(0.25)/lb Cu.
summary_long: Revenue of $631.3M was below Q1's $757.3M, reflecting a planned Peru semi-annual plant maintenance shutdown and modestly weaker gold output. Consolidated cash cost remained negative at $(0.40)/lb Cu. Peru cash cost of $1.66/lb outperformed the low end of guidance. Adjusted EBITDA of $321.2M brought TTM EBITDA to a record $1,271.6M. Free cash flow was $101.8M, bringing H1 above $200M despite $200M+ of sustaining capex. Cash of $890.9M reflects the $472.5M April repayment of 2026 senior notes and a $272M revolver draw. Net debt turned to negative $80.5M.

drivers.explanation: Planned Peru semi-annual plant maintenance shutdown reduced copper output; gold production came in slightly below quarterly cadence.
Strong gold by-product credits and operating efficiencies more than offset higher fuel and consumable input costs, letting the company improve full-year cost guidance below the prior low end.
Repaid $472.5M of 2026 senior unsecured notes on April 1 maturity and drew $272M on low-cost revolvers. Total liquidity remained above $1.0B.

confidence_notes: Filing-based summary from Exhibit 99.3 news release accompanying the July 29 2026 6-K. All KPI values, drivers, and guidance quoted directly from the release. Q/Q deltas vs the prior HBM_US_FY2026_Q1 summary. Adjusted EBITDA, cash cost, and FCF are non-GAAP measures as disclosed by the company.
